summary: Publication-ready. Live checks confirmed that all eight cited URLs resolve and materially support the associated claims, including Google’s guidance on people-first and AI-generated content, scaled content abuse, Analytics–Search Console reporting, and attribution limits. RankPill’s help center lists WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Webflow, Framer, and webhook guides; its pricing page displays plan features and billing options; and its quiz offers a personalized content plan. The article is substantive, balanced, naturally written, aligned with buyer intent, and appropriately distinguishes first-party vendor positioning from verified performance. Its controlled-trial framework, evaluation checklist, cost considerations, and relevant final CTA provide practical value without unsupported promises.
